part.text: The warehouse has premium, claim-payment, and commission data. It lacks earned premium, which is needed for a standard loss ratio. For net written premium, I’ll use booked premium less cancellations, excluding quotes, and state that calculation explicitly.

input.command: sqlite3 -header -column warehouse.db "SELECT 'q1' AS question, g.region, ROUND(SUM(p.premium_amt - COALESCE(p.cancellation_amt,0)),2) AS net_written_premium FROM fct_policy_premium p JOIN dim_geography g ON g.geo_id=p.geo_id WHERE p.status IN ('written','cancelled') AND p.eff_dt >= '2026-07-01' AND p.eff_dt < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY g.region ORDER BY g.region; SELECT 'q2' AS question, d.product_line, ROUND(SUM(p.premium_amt_gross),2) AS gross_written_premium FROM fct_policy_premium p JOIN dim_product d ON d.product_id=p.product_id WHERE p.status IN ('written','cancelled') AND p.eff_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND p.eff_dt < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY d.product_line ORDER BY d.product_line; SELECT 'q3' AS question, COUNT(DISTINCT policy_id) AS policies_written FROM fct_policy_premium WHERE status='written' AND eff_dt >= '2026-03-01' AND eff_dt < '2026-04-01'; SELECT 'q4' AS question, severity, ROUND(SUM(paid_amt),2) AS paid_on_closed_claims FROM fct_claims WHERE status='closed' AND closed_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND closed_dt < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY severity ORDER BY severity; SELECT 'q6' AS question, ROUND(SUM(commission_amt),2) AS commissions_paid FROM fct_commissions WHERE paid_dt >= '2026-07-01' AND paid_dt < '2026-10-01'; SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS premium_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT policy_id) AS policies, SUM(CASE WHEN premium_amt IS NULL OR premium_amt_gross IS NULL OR cancellation_amt IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_amounts FROM fct_policy_premium WHERE eff_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND eff_dt < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY status;"
